title: IIHT SUTRA 2026 Held as First National Conclave

blocks.content: IIHT SUTRA 2026 was held on 12 August 2026 at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre in New Delhi as the first National Conclave of the Indian Institutes of Handloom Technology (IIHTs). The event was organised by the Ministry of Textiles through the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms) and brought together institutional, academic, and industry stakeholders linked to handloom education.

items: The Ministry of Textiles handles policy and institutional support for India’s handloom sector through the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms).
Indian Institutes of Handloom Technology are specialised institutions connected with handloom training and technical education.
Handloom education in India includes design, weaving technology, product development, and sector-specific skill training.
Memoranda of Understanding are formal agreements used by government bodies, academic institutions, and industry partners for cooperation.
